title: Runaway animation loop causing exponential ball acceleration and browser lag in BoardComponent
summary: Runaway animation loop causing exponential ball acceleration and browser lag in BoardComponent
reporter: Marcus Vance (QA Lead, Arcade Gaming Group)
description:
When a player loads the brick breaker game, the ball starts at standard velocity, but within 3 to 5 seconds the game loop accelerates uncontrollably. The ball travels at extreme speed across the canvas, teleporting through paddle boundaries and causing CPU utilization to spike to 100% on the browser tab.

Affected component: src/app/board/board.component.ts (BoardComponent)

Diagnostic Evidence & Console Logs:
[Violation] 'requestAnimationFrame' handler took 18ms
Animation frame callback count: 1200 calls/sec (expected: 60 fps)
Call Tree: BoardComponent.drawGame -> requestAnimationFrame
           BoardComponent.gameLoop -> requestAnimationFrame
steps: Observe canvas rendering during initial 5 seconds
Inspect Chrome DevTools Performance Profiler requestAnimationFrame call tree
Observe runaway frame scheduling and uncontrolled ball velocity
impact: Game becomes unplayable within 5 seconds of launch; causes tab freeze and high CPU utilization on client devices.
